Rule.cleave: Make a melee attack with this weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first and within your reach. On a hit it takes the weapon's damage without your ability modifier (unless the modifier is negative). Once per turn.
Rule.graze: The attack missed, but the target takes damage equal to the ability modifier used for the attack, of the weapon's damage type.
Rule.nick: When you make the extra attack from the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. Once per turn.
Rule.push: Push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from you if it is Large or smaller.
Rule.sap: The creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
Rule.slow: The creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Multiple Slow hits don't reduce it by more than 10 feet.
Rule.topple: The creature makes a Constitution saving throw (DC {dc}) or has the Prone condition.
Rule.vex: You have Advantage on your next attack roll against this creature before the end of your next turn.

ToppleResult.fail: Failed the save and is Prone

Cleave.Title: Cleave: {weapon}

autoApply.name: Apply Automatically
autoApply.hint: Apply Graze damage, Sap, Slow and Vex, and roll Topple saves, as soon as the chat card is posted. Push is always a button because it's optional.

cleaveDialog.name: Cleave Target Dialog
cleaveDialog.hint: Open a dialog to pick a second target after a Cleave hit.

playerButtons.name: Players Can Use Buttons
playerButtons.hint: Let the attacking player click the chat card buttons. When off, only the GM sees them.
